parent.hypothesis: Float32 network VJP accumulation, rather than nonadditive loss partitioning, explains the reproduced component-sum discrepancy.

fixed_inputs.pair: Exactly the sole pair in the bound investigation JSON, itself a member of the original 72-pair preregistration; no new case or pair.

native_observation.random_observer: Call the original torch.randn_like unchanged, return its exact result and only retain detached copies of its three native classifier standard-Gaussian draws.

reference.model: Isolated deep-copy of the same frozen student, all floating model parameters and buffers converted to float64; original models unchanged.
reference.mode: Same eval mode and official UNet/3x3 classifier implementation as the native probe.
reference.forward: One student-unlabeled forward in float64 on the original image tensor cast to float64.
reference.randomness: Temporarily replay the captured student-unlabeled float32 standard-Gaussian values, cast to float64, at the sole official torch.randn_like call. Do not sample a new float64 draw using the old seed.
reference.input_target_weights_strata: Reuse the failed native teacher-probability, R2 weight and teacher-predicted class tensors, detach and cast only as needed; no rescoring or mask/stratum change.
reference.objective: Unchanged gradients.objective, R2/class_balanced, once total and once per each of the three original class components.
reference.gradients: Four independent autograd.grad calls on the same shadow graph, retain graph as needed, no backward or parameter.grad writes.
forbidden: total defined as sum of components
straight-through replacement of reference forward values
replacing native evidence with the reference
changing class masks, teacher target, weights or reliability formulas

required_checks: Native original failure and all previous tensor/gradient hashes reproduce on both devices.
The observer records exactly three expected float32 standard-Gaussian draws and alters neither native outputs nor random realization.
The single float64 forward consumes exactly the first captured draw, changes no CPU/CUDA RNG state and preserves all target/weight/stratum values.
Record original tolerance residuals for global plus all six parameter blocks, including violating counts, norms and hashes, without dropping failed blocks.
Record native/reference logits, probabilities and active gradient differences, cosines, norm ratios and relative L2 errors, plus component-wise comparisons.
Run the original isolation helper on captured probe_unit exception locals before and after the reference; compare legacy/current/history hashes and all model state groups.
Verify original and shadow model parameters/buffers/GAS states unchanged within their respective dtypes, teacher frozen, inactive gradients None, all parameter.grad fields None.
Verify all nine original checkpoint hashes and frozen formal failure/manifest hashes after execution.
Publish both replicas and any failure without selecting a favorable device or automatically retrying.

interpretation.numerical_reference_supported_only_if: Both replicas reproduce native failure and satisfy all provenance/isolation checks; float64 decomposition passes the unchanged componentwise predicate in all seven blocks, and global relative L2 component-sum residual is at most 1e-10.
interpretation.comparability_not_met: Report HIGH_PRECISION_DECOMPOSITION_ONLY_NONCOMPARABLE rather than claiming the native discrepancy is resolved.
interpretation.reference_decomposition_not_met: Report FP64_REFERENCE_NOT_SUPPORTING_HYPOTHESIS and stop this finite probe; no precision/backend search.
interpretation.scope: Numerical forensics only. No original Gate1C rescue, no scientific admission, no claim that all 72 pairs work, and no automatic formal retry.

execution.next_action: Analyze both fixed replicas, publish their complete receipts and only then record a separate prospective plan for any further diagnostic or implementation.
